headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 8, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested game, with Gerrit Cole leading the way for the Yankees with 7.0 innings pitched and 9 strikeouts. The Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tyler Soderstrom hitting a home run and driving in one run in four at-bats. The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 victory, with Sandy Alcantara pitching 7.0 innings and striking out 8 batters.

Several players have been impacted by injuries and availability. Jack Leiter has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right ankle posterior impingement. Ben Williamson has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to August 6, 2026, with a right hamstring strain. Cole Wilcox has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a left oblique strain. Joe Ryan has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 5, 2026, with a left glute strain. Slade Cecconi has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right arm fatigue. Chris Murphy has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a left flexor strain. Joey Bart has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a fifth metacarpal fracture in his left hand. Luis Urías has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right quad strain.

The Kansas City Royals have acquired 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins in a trade. The Athletics have acquired RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for RF Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins have traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies have traded RHP Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for 1B Connor Norby and RHP Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested game. Gerrit Cole led the way for the Yankees with a strong 7.0 innings pitched, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Red Sox 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tyler Soderstrom leading the team at the plate. Soderstrom hit a home run and drove in one run in four at-bats.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Down Angels 7-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 victory, with Sandy Alcantara leading the way on the mound. Alcantara pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 8 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Phillies 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 7-5 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Nathan Lukes leading the offense. Lukes hit 3 home runs, including a key 6th homer that scored Brandon Valenzuela.

top_news.title: **Rangers' Jack Leiter Shifted to 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers right-handed pitcher Jack Leiter has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right ankle posterior impingement.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals after being traded in a deal that brings him to the Midwest.
